## Grizzled Mercenary (CR 4)

**XP** 1,200  
 Human warrior 6  
 CN Medium humanoid (human)  
 **Init** +4; **Senses** Perception +4  

**Defense**

 **AC** 18, touch 10, flat-footed 18 (+8 armor)  
 **hp** 51 (6d10+18)  
 **Fort** +7, **Ref** +5, **Will** +3  
 **DR** 4/slashing (ranged attacks only)  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 20 ft.  
 **Melee** mwk halberd +10/+5 (1d10+3/×3) or longspear +8/+3 (1d8+3/×3) or morningstar +8/+3 (1d8+2) or cold iron kukri +8/+3 (1d4+2/18–20)  
 **Ranged** musket +6 (1d12/x4)  
 **Space** 5 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft. (10 ft. with longspear)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 14, **Dex** 10, **Con** 12, **Int** 9, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 8  
 **Base Atk** +6; **CMB** +8; **CMD** 18  
 **Feats** [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), [Weapon Focus (halberd)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md), [Lightning Reflexes](../../rules/feats/lightning-reflexes.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Diehard and Endurance and Toughness are one feat, Toughness; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (halberd), Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes.*  
 **Skills** Climb +0, Handle Animal +3, Intimidate +6, Knowledge (local) +0, Perception +4, Swim +0  
 **Languages** Common  
 **Combat Gear** potion of cure moderate wounds, concussion grenade, holy water, alchemist’s fire; **Other Gear** masterwork ballistic enhancement half-plate, musket with 10 metal cartridges, cold iron kukri, longspear, masterwork halberd, morningstar, cloak of resistance +1, handlight, 4 gp.
